Title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
DisplayTitle: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect Fuel Tanks and Escort Employees
Description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
